sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: In this catalogue, Echinacea refers to purple coneflower, Echinacea purpurea, a perennial of prairies and woodland margins in the eastern and central United States. It can reach about 1.8 m.

sections.title: Flowering
sections.text: Flower heads reach about 15 cm across and combine a raised central disk with drooping outer florets, usually purple to pink.

sections.title: Food use and cautions
sections.text: Petals are eaten in some culinary uses, but this is not a recommendation for medicinal use. Allergic reactions are possible; the botanical sources do not establish therapeutic efficacy.
